about_the_game:
PEAKPOWER is a 2D physics based open world sandbox set in a world filled with heroes and villains. Shape your own character, from appearance to various powers. Fight, flight, leap a whole block, swing from the top of buildings, dodge bullets, laser everybody who crosses your path or protect the life of those who wouldn't do the same to you. PEAKPOWER is all about giving you tools to experience how superpowers would work in a scenario where there's no plot armor or guarantee of success.

With physics driven gameplay most attacks transfer kinetic energy, heavy objects can knock you and your foes out of balance, super strong or fast heroes need to be careful around regular thugs, all sorts of unexpected things can happen in the heat of battle, with fine real-time control over how much force you apply to interactions, PEAKPOWER allows you to approach different situations the way you best see fit.

PEAKPOWER let you obtain a extensive arsenal that ranges from sledgehammers and knives to rifles, cursed swords and magical artifacts. It is up to you to define your character by experiment with various clothes, suits and costumes that go from pure cosmetic changes and fashion to gameplay altering.

IMPORTANT MECHANICS AND FEATURES

  • physics driven gameplay (active ragdolls)

  • detailed physiology (internal fluids and injury severity)

  • aerodynamic simulation (drag, lift, pressure and temperature)

  • fluid simulation (liquids and gases)

  • NPC combat coordination

Note: PEAKPOWER is in active development, all mentioned features are functional or polished, but still subject to changes.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains and depicts violence, blood, injuries, gore, death and fictional substances and drug usage.
